The DOI is **10.1515/THLI.2008.007**, which is the same identifier as the team note's `10.1515/thli.2008.007` (DOIs are case-insensitive). A search returned a de Gruyter PDF link under that DOI for the Croft & Poole *Theoretical Linguistics* article, but I could not read the paywalled page to confirm the exact title. I'd rule out `10.1515/lity.2008.007`, since "lity" is not this journal's DOI prefix.

CONFIDENCE: 80
